description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - story look: a picture-book co-reading helper for parents - LOOK takes a default-mode photo of the page as a record only (the runtime has no OCR and the language model takes text only, so the glasses never see or read the page), SAY hears the parent describe this page in one sentence (wearer-mode mic, kept verbatim), TELL sends that description plus the previous pages' descriptions as text only to the host LLM, which returns a warm 2-3 sentence narration for a 3-6 year old and one question to ask the child, falling back to a labelled OFFLINE ECHO (the parent's own words read back as-is plus a rotating built-in bank of 10 gentle questions), READ speaks the narration only when the parent taps it - never automatically, so generated text is previewed on screen before it reaches the child - and NEXT files each page into the last story on device (key storyLook, max 20 pages) for a full READ ALL replay
name: story-look
